dedupe_keys.name: tallinna tehnikaulikooli taltech linnaku andmestik taltech campus dataset

description: Tallinn University of Technology publishes heat and electricity time series for most buildings on its Mustamäe campus in Tallinn, Estonia. Anna Volkova, Birgit-Lume Paju, Vahur Maask and Martin Thalfeldt deposited the resource for teaching, service development and model testing. The stated period is 1 January 2022 to 31 December 2025, with actual coverage and measurement intervals recorded separately for each meter and year. Heat variables include energy, flow, supply and return temperatures and instantaneous power. Electricity variables include energy imports and exports, active and reactive power, current and voltage. Building identifiers connect the CSV series to an Excel overview containing subsystem labels, units, meter identifiers and filenames. Public repository downloads are available at no stated charge. The TalTech Dataset Use Agreement permits non-commercial research and education, prohibits redistribution and substantially reproducing datasets without permission, and allows published analyses or models that do not reconstruct the data. Coverage is expanded in successive versions; complete campus coverage and uniform intervals are not claimed. These observations support testing of building energy performance models. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
